coverage: Every complete source uses a real public-sync snapshot on Memory and SQLite; half also deliver the target or control child through an incremental stream prelude.
Cascade, set-null and restrict each cover an update to the expiry boundary, a future-expiry control and an expired parent with no inbound reference.
The negative family covers an unprovable empty private group, a wholly audience-hidden child and a visible-plus-hidden partially acquired group for every action.

No unknown or incomplete answer counts as parity: complete cases assert the exact action result and data image; incomplete cases require E_PREDICT and byte-equivalent authored rows before and after prediction.
